lines.meet: I'm Karim, a felsworn and a tank. Yes, the eyes are green, and yes, it was a choice, so ask or don't, but please stop staring.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Undercrust, below the Flats, I've passed you there. I'm Karim, the one with the survey notes and the green eyes.
lines.ask_home: Which country did you come from? A short answer is fine.
lines.ask_work: Your old profession, what was it? I'd rather ask than guess wrongly.
lines.answer_home: Amman, where my father was an engineer and my mother taught school.
lines.answer_work: Land surveyor, fifteen years, mostly in the empty desert east of the city. Weeks at a time with nobody around, and I loved it.
lines.chat_food: Black coffee with cardamom, in the desert at dawn. I never needed much else, and I still don't.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep well, as I always have. Empty country teaches you to sleep on anything.
lines.chat_missing: A true line across empty ground, and the moment a survey closes perfectly. Nothing here closes perfectly.
lines.chat_here: I took the fel deliberately, after consideration, as the fastest way to be useful in a fight. I'll defend that choice to anybody who raises it.
lines.tease_quiet: We'd survey well together, {name}. Neither of us would say a word for a week.
lines.tease_talker: You've filled the whole valley with words, {name}. I'll have to re-survey it.
lines.tease_careful: You check your bearings three times, {name}. I approve, with reservations about the time it takes.
lines.tease_bold: You walk straight off the edge of the map, {name}. Somebody has to draw the line where you fell.
lines.tease_any: You're imprecise, {name}, and I like you anyway. I find that irritating.
lines.tease_back: That was accurate, {name}. I'll allow it.
lines.bristle: I'd prefer that didn't become a joke, {name}, so leave it alone.
lines.apologise: That was badly put, and I'm sorry. I'm blunt, but I'm not usually cruel.
lines.double_down: It was true, and I'll repeat it if you need me to.
lines.needle_quiet: You've got a question and you won't ask it. Ask it, or stop looking at me like that.
lines.needle_talker: Your words have no edges. Say the thing, and stop there.
lines.needle_careful: You've measured it enough. More readings won't change the ground.
lines.needle_bold: You run without a bearing, and you expect the rest of us to find you.
lines.needle_any: You pity people, and you pity me. I'm tired of it, and I don't need it.
lines.bite_back: I chose every part of what I am, carefully. Don't lecture me about choices.
lines.hurt: That's fair, and I don't like it. I'll walk ahead for a while.
lines.laugh_off: I've been called worse by people who knew me better. Let's keep moving.
lines.confide: {name}, my brother moved to Toronto years ago. We called every week, then every month, then not at all. I never decided to stop, and I think about that.
lines.listen: No pity, {name}, I promise you that. It stays exactly as you said it.
lines.look_out: Stay behind me in there, {name}. I'm the one built to take it.
lines.deflect: No pity, please, {name}. It's minor, and you know it is.
lines.check_in: Where, {name}, and how deep? Precise answers, please.
lines.blame: Somebody went off the line we agreed, and the survey failed. I know whose reading it was.
lines.thank: I was gone, and now I'm not. Thank you, plainly.
lines.brush_off: It needed doing, and I did it. No need for anything else.
lines.worry: Sit down, {name}. That was outside any tolerance I'd accept for you.
lines.handed_down: This was on you before. I'll keep it true until you want it.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, it does more for you than for me. I don't need much.
lines.hand_sulk: Somebody could have asked. I'd have answered.
lines.turn_friendly: You've stayed, {name}, after I was blunt with you. Most people don't, and I've noticed.
lines.turn_friends: I'd take you surveying in empty country, {name}, for weeks. That's the best thing I know how to offer.
lines.turn_grating: We don't work, you and I. I'd rather name it than draw around it.
lines.turn_rivals: The job needs a tank, so I'll take the hits for you, and nothing else.
lines.make_up: My judgement of you was wrong, {name}, and I'll correct the map. Let's start again.
lines.defend: That's imprecise and unfair. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s away, and the silence is less comfortable than usual. I didn't expect that.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name}'s back. The party's properly surveyed again.
lines.common_fel: I took the fel deliberately, after a lot of thought. People who've chosen it the same way are the only ones who don't stare.
lines.common_numbers: I've spent my life making lines come out true. People who work with numbers don't round things off, and you don't either.
lines.common_desert: Fifteen years in the empty desert east of Amman, weeks at a time alone. People who know the desert know it's never empty.
lines.common_arabic: You speak Arabic. Good, it's easier to be precise in your own language.
